TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the massive pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Receives pricingRuleRequest and invokes ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules with the complete DTO. The library validates that the request contains details, that it has at least two ACT details, that ACT ids are not duplicated, validates each generated pricing rule before any insertion, and resolves detail values before persistence. 2. It builds one pricing rule per ACT detail, copies the common rule data to every generated rule, ignores input CUS details in that construction, and keeps separate branches for invalid details, duplicate conflicts, date validation failures, and persistence failures. 3. It invokes ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules to obtain sequence ids, create a massive custom attribute with attributeName MASIVA, insert audit records, persist each generated pricing rule, add a generated CUS detail linked to that custom attribute to every created rule, and return the created list. 4. If any validation or persistence step raises a PricingRuleException, the library adds the corresponding advice with description, returns an empty list, and the transaction sets severity EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. It assigns pricingRulesResponse with the list returned by the library, containing one created PricingRuleDTO per ACT detail.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Creates one pricing rule per ACT detail from the request, validates all generated rules before insertion, adds a generated MASIVA CUS detail to each created rule, and returns the created list.
